items.title: Anthropic 修订版 S1 文件披露与 Microsoft 和 Google 超 100 亿美元级新算力协议 / Anthropic reveals in its amended S1 filing today, more than $10 billion in new agreements with Microsoft and Google.

sources.title: Anthropic 修订版 S1 文件披露与 Microsoft 和 Google 超 100 亿美元级新算力协议 / Anthropic reveals in its amended S1 filing today, more than $10 billion in new agreements with Microsoft and Google.
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 修订版 S1 文件披露与 Microsoft 和 Google 超 100 亿美元级新算力协议
sources.title_en: Anthropic reveals in its amended S1 filing today, more than $10 billion in new agreements with Microsoft and Google.
sources.title_original: Anthropic reveals in its amended S1 filing today, more than $10 billion in new agreements with Microsoft and Google.
sources.summary: Anthropic 在当日修订的 S1 文件中披露与 Microsoft 和 Google 达成超 100 亿美元的新协议。Microsoft 承诺到 2033 年 6 月支出至少 472 亿、最高 492 亿美元，Google 最低承诺从约 1145 亿升至约 1213 亿美元，两笔均不可撤销、无论是否使用容量都须付款。文件还提到上季度短期算力支出 50 亿美元且价格明显更高。

items.title_en: Anthropic reveals in its amended S1 filing today, more than $10 billion in new agreements with Microsoft and Google.
items.title_original: Anthropic reveals in its amended S1 filing today, more than $10 billion in new agreements with Microsoft and Google.
items.summary: Anthropic 在当日修订的 S1 文件中披露与 Microsoft 和 Google 达成超 100 亿美元的新协议。Microsoft 承诺到 2033 年 6 月支出至少 472 亿、最高 492 亿美元，Google 最低承诺从约 1145 亿升至约 1213 亿美元，两笔均不可撤销、无论是否使用容量都须付款。文件还提到上季度短期算力支出 50 亿美元且价格明显更高。
